fields.duties:
Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that enable robots to operate in complex, unpredictable environments. By combining advanced AI, robotics, and real-world deployment experience, we are developing solutions that move beyond simulation and deliver measurable impact across industries.
Our systems are already deployed globally, helping customers unlock new possibilities in construction, security, mining, manufacturing, and beyond. We are building the foundation for the next generation of embodied intelligence—where robots can understand, navigate, and operate safely in the world around them.
About the Job
Field AI is building the future of autonomy—from rugged field environments to real-world customer deployments. We’re looking for a Mapping Solution Engineer who can bring our 3D mapping solutions to life by owning deployment, integration, and ongoing performance in the field.
This role sits at the intersection of robotics engineering, customer delivery, and technical problem-solving. You’ll work hands-on with 3D mapping systems, robots, sensors, and customer environments to ensure successful deployments while continuously improving reliability through field feedback.
You’ll collaborate closely with software engineers, robotics teams, operations, and customers to deliver mapping solutions that operate in large-scale, unstructured environments. If you enjoy building technology that leaves the lab, solving complex real-world problems, and seeing your work directly enable autonomous systems, this is your role.
What You’ll Get To Do
1. Develop and Deploy 3D Mapping Solutions
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade software for 3D mapping applications.
Deploy large-scale mapping systems and data processing pipelines into real-world environments.
Validate mapping systems and algorithms through testing on robots, sensors, and field deployments.
Build internal tooling, automation, and benchmarking infrastructure to improve reliability, performance, and repeatability.
Troubleshoot and optimize mapping workflows across software, hardware, and data pipelines.
2. Own Solution Delivery and Field Deployment
Lead end-to-end delivery of mapping data products, including data capture, processing, quality validation, and customer handoff.
Support on-site and remote deployments, ensuring systems are operational and performing as expected.
Conduct technical demonstrations, pilots, and evaluations for prospective and existing customers.
Partner with internal engineering teams and customers to identify issues, gather feedback, and drive improvements.
Develop scalable deployment processes, documentation, and best practices to improve future rollouts.
3. Bridge Field Operations and Engineering
Translate real-world deployment challenges into actionable technical improvements.
Analyze field data and system performance to improve mapping reliability and customer outcomes.
Work across robotics, software, operations, and customer teams to solve complex technical challenges.
Support mission-critical robotic deployments in dynamic and unpredictable environments.
What You Have
Master’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Geomatics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
2+ years of experience in robotics software development, 3D mapping, systems integration, or field deployment of complex technical systems.
Strong programming skills in C++ and Python with experience writing production-quality software.
Experience with 3D geometry, point cloud processing, and algorithms such as ICP and NDT.
Familiarity with point cloud libraries and tools such as PCL or Open3D.
Experience working with LiDAR systems and 3D data formats including PCD, PLY, E57, or LAS.
Familiarity with ROS, Git, and Linux/Ubuntu-based development environments.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, and networking systems.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Willingness to travel and work on-site with customers as needed.
The Extras That Set You Apart
Experience with geospatial data, georeferencing, coordinate systems, survey control, or calibration workflows.
Experience deploying and maintaining mission-critical robotics or autonomous systems in real-world environments.
Familiarity with point cloud and survey software such as CloudCompare, Leica Cyclone, Faro Scene, or Trimble RealWorks.
Experience working directly with customers in high-stakes technical environments.
Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Wrike, or Confluence.
Background in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, or field robotics.
Experience working at a startup or high-growth company with a strong ownership mindset.
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world’s most complex challenges: deploying intelligent robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ enable robots to perceive, reason, and operate safely in the real world, creating a new generation of autonomous systems.
You’ll work alongside a world-class team of researchers, engineers, and builders from organizations including DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX.
At Field AI, you’ll have the opportunity to work on technology that moves beyond the lab—building systems that operate in the real world and redefine what robots can do.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We’re looking for people who challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and thrive in environments where the answers aren’t already known. Join a team of engineers, researchers, field operators, and innovators working together to bring embodied intelligence into the world.


Compensation and Benefits
We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary; base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  Also, while we enjoy being together on-site, we are open to exploring a hybrid or remote option.
 
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world’s most complex challenges: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ set a new standard in perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, ensuring our approach is explainable and safe for deployment.
 
You will have the opportunity to work with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. With a decade-long track record of deploying solutions in the field, winning DARPA challenge segments, and bringing expertise from organizations like DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise Self-Driving, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, we are set to achieve our ambitious goals.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
To tackle such ambitious challenges, we need a team as unique as our vision — innovators who go beyond conventional methods and are eager to tackle tough, uncharted questions. We’re seeking individuals who challenge the status quo, dive into uncharted territory, and bring interdisciplinary expertise. Our team requires not only top AI talent but also exceptional software developers, engineers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators.
 
We are headquartered in always-sunny Irvine, Southern California and have US based and global teammates. 
 
Join us, shape the future, and be part of a fun, close-knit team on an exciting journey!

A Figure é uma empresa de robótica e IA que desenvolve robôs humanoides autônomos de uso geral. O objetivo da empresa é lançar robôs humanoides com inteligência de nível humano. Seus robôs são projetados para executar uma grande variedade de tarefas nos mercados residencial e comercial. A Figure tem sede em San Jose, Califórnia, e está estabelecendo sua primeira unidade de operações de dados no Brasil.
Estamos construindo a base de dados que dá vida aos nossos robôs humanoides. O time de Data Operations cria e faz a curadoria dos dados que treinam nossos sistemas de IA, e a organização de Data Creators é responsável por como esses dados são capturados, em que volume e com qual padrão de qualidade, em todas as nossas unidades.
Como
Technical Coordinator (Coordenador Técnico)
, você é o dono da frente técnica da unidade: hardware, inventário, manutenção e suporte técnico no chão de operação. Você recebe, monta, calibra e mantém todos os equipamentos de captura, de trajes de sensores e headsets a câmeras, rigs (estruturas de suporte) e rede, e constrói os sistemas de inventário e manutenção que mantêm a unidade rodando conforme ela escala. Quando uma estação para, você é a primeira linha de resposta; quando um problema vai além da sua bancada, você é a ponte com os times de hardware e engenharia da Figure na Califórnia. Você também vai orientar os Data Creators no uso correto dos equipamentos e na técnica de captura, protegendo a qualidade dos dados na origem.
Jornada:
A unidade opera 24/7. Esta posição atua principalmente no turno da manhã, com flexibilidade para entradas mais cedo, saídas mais tarde ou cobertura ocasional aos fins de semana quando um problema crítico de hardware exigir.
Responsabilidades
Ser o dono, de ponta a ponta, da frente técnica da unidade: hardware, inventário, manutenção e suporte técnico no chão de operação.
Receber, inventariar, implantar e manter todos os equipamentos de captura (trajes de sensores, headsets, câmeras, rigs, baterias, carregamento, rede) e construir o sistema de inventário e controle de ativos da unidade.
Montar e calibrar as estações de captura, mantê-las dentro das especificações e aplicar atualizações de firmware e software seguindo as orientações da matriz (HQ).
Fazer o troubleshooting (diagnóstico e resolução de falhas) de primeira linha em problemas de hardware e captura durante os turnos, minimizando o tempo de estação parada.
Gerenciar escalações para os times de hardware e engenharia nos EUA: documentar problemas com logs (registros), fotos e passos de reprodução claros o suficiente para depuração assíncrona, e conduzir o ciclo de RMA (devolução e troca com o fabricante) e de peças de reposição, considerando os prazos de importação.
Desenhar e rodar o programa de manutenção preventiva: cronogramas de manutenção, registros de ciclo de vida dos equipamentos e uma estratégia de peças sobressalentes que mantenha a unidade operando entre os ciclos de reposição.
Dar coaching (orientação prática) presencial e assistência técnica aos Data Creators: posicionamento dos sensores, colocação e retirada dos trajes e técnica de captura.
Escrever e manter os SOPs técnicos (procedimentos operacionais padrão) da unidade, cobrindo setup, calibração, troubleshooting e manutenção, em parceria com os Project e Shift Coordinators, e treinar os Creators no cuidado com os equipamentos.
Ajudar a construir o time técnico conforme a unidade escala, incluindo onboarding (integração) e mentoria dos futuros técnicos de campo.
Requisitos
2+ anos de experiência prática em manutenção, troubleshooting ou reparo de equipamentos eletrônicos ou eletromecânicos (atendimento técnico em campo/field service, laboratório, áudio e vídeo/broadcast, equipamentos médicos, automação industrial, hardware de TI ou similar), com histórico comprovado de responsabilidade de ponta a ponta por um processo ou sistema técnico.
Troubleshooting sistemático: capacidade de isolar falhas entre as camadas de hardware, cabeamento, firmware e software.
Familiaridade com ferramentas e instrumentos de bancada: multímetro, conectores e cabeamento, gravação de firmware (flashing) e redes básicas.
Forte disciplina de documentação: registros de manutenção, controles de inventário e relatos de problemas que outras pessoas, inclusive engenheiros remotos, consigam usar para agir.
Perfil didático e paciente, confortável em apoiar operadores não técnicos em um chão de operação movimentado.
Inglês em nível profissional (documentação técnica e escalações com a engenharia nos EUA; a maior parte da colaboração é escrita e assíncrona).
Flexibilidade para apoiar ocasionalmente outros turnos em uma operação 24/7.
Diferenciais
Formação técnica (SENAI, ETEC ou similar) ou graduação em eletrônica, mecatrônica, engenharia elétrica ou área relacionada.
Experiência prática com headsets de VR/AR, sistemas de captura de movimento (motion capture), robótica ou drones.
Experiência de field service em equipamentos importados ou especializados, incluindo processos de RMA com fabricantes no exterior.
Experiência construindo ou operando sistemas de inventário, controle de ativos ou gestão de manutenção (CMMS).
Habilidade de solda e retrabalho, ou experiência com fabricação (impressão 3D, gabaritos e dispositivos de fixação).
Experiência em startups de rápido crescimento.
Remuneração
Salário base:
R$ 7.000 a R$ 10.000 por mês
Benefícios:
vale-transporte, vale-refeição e plano de saúde

About Nimble
Nimble
is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you.
We are on a mission to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial. We will accomplish this by training robot AGI to invent and build the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by generalist superhumanoids.
Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including
Fei-Fei Li
(Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab),
Marc Raibert
(founder of Boston Dynamics), and
Sebastian Thrun
(founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles).
Let’s be legendary.
Nimble's Core Values:
1) Be relentlessly resourceful -
Find a way to make the impossible, possible. Do whatever it takes.
2) Be legendary -
Be the best at whatever it is that you do. Leave your mark. Motivate and inspire others.
3) Be humble -
Leave your ego behind. Have a growth mindset. Learn and improve yourself every day.
4) Be dependable -
Take ownership and deliver. Be loyal to your team and Nimble's mission.
About the Role
Nimble Robotics is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician for an e-commerce fulfillment facility. Under general supervision, the technician performs critical corrective and preventive maintenance on mechanical equipment, material handling equipment, automated equipment, tools, buildings and grounds. This is a maintenance and repair position that is crucial in the daily operations of the fulfillment center.
Responsibilities
Work with management and lead technicians to prioritize daily tasks and assignments.
Effect repairs on machines, tools, building infrastructure, and other grounds equipment and resources.
Inspect, evaluate, and repair a variety of mechanical equipment.
Regularly uses assigned software to enter work done on work orders, and to track daily tasks & assignments.
Communicate with team members on site and abroad to gather necessary information for accurate repairs.
Maintain accurate records of work performed, parts used, and time taken for tasks.
Read and interpret specifications, diagrams, manuals and other documentation such as standard operating procedures created by engineering and management.
Confer with staff to determine equipment problems; suggest methods of minimizing such problems in an operational setting.
Help to maintain inventory levels of supplies, tools, and replacement parts. Working with management and distribution to ensure stock is replaced in a timely manner.
Follow appropriate safety procedures and work to applicable codes and guidelines, including making recommendations for improvements.
Attend training and safety sessions as assigned.
Basic Qualifications
Equivalent to graduation from high school and three years of experience in the maintenance and repair of a variety of equipment, structures, and facilities such as found in similar industrial settings
Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Write reports, correspondence and procedures.
Effectively respond to questions from staff, other departments’ managers, and technical representatives.
Must be able to use computer systems including but are not limited to: Google Suite, Slack, Microsoft Visual Studio, command prompts, Click Up, and other various software applications.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to recognize, mitigate, and correct unsafe conditions.
Ability to interact with others (co-workers, supervisors, subordinates) in a professional manner; to accept constructive criticism from supervisors, equals, and subordinates; to work as a team member or independently as needed; to prioritize assignments and meet deadlines; to prevent personal problems from adversely impacting your work or that of others around you; to arrive at work as scheduled and to work the shift hours as scheduled.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability, fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations
Additional Requirements
Regularly required to use hand tools, to reach with hands and arms into tight spaces, and to talk or hear in person or on the telephone or radio
Hearing is frequently required for equipment operation analysis
Required to work and walk at elevated heights, using fall protection equipment.
Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl to access necessary equipment.
Occasionally required to smell, using odors to determine process or equipment problems.
Regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 40 pounds, and occasionally be required to lift and/or move more than 50 pounds.
Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
Ability to work on-call/stand-by, overtime, weekends and holidays as needed
Work location is in a warehouse environment with variable temperature including cold, heat and humidity
Exposure to moving mechanical parts; fumes or airborne particles; occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; manufacturing conditions; heat; risk of electric shock; and vibration
$30 - $40 an hour
Culture
We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit!

About Nimble
Nimble
is a robotics and AI company building end-to-end autonomous logistics to enable fast, efficient, and sustainable commerce. We’re developing generalized robot intelligence and building general-purpose logistics robots, the first in the world capable of performing all core warehouse functions.
Our mission is to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial.
Our long-term vision is to invent the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – using next-gen intelligent robotics to deliver faster, more efficient, and more sustainable commerce.
We were founded from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon. We’re backed by the World’s most prestigious investors as well as AI and robotics legends like
Marc Raibert
(Founder of Boston Dynamics),
Fei-Fei Li
(Chief Scientist of AI at Google, Director of Stanford’s AI lab), and
Sebastian Thrun
(Founder of Google X, Waymo, Kitty Hawk, and Udacity)!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e3XPfrlkO7s
Nimble's Core Values:
1) Be relentlessly resourceful -
Find a way to make the impossible, possible. Do whatever it takes.
2) Be legendary -
Be the best at whatever it is that you do. Leave your mark. Motivate and inspire others.
3) Be humble -
Leave your ego behind. Have a growth mindset. Learn and improve yourself every day.
4) Be dependable -
Take ownership and deliver. Be loyal to your team and Nimble's mission.
About the Role
Nimble Robotics is seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician for an e-commerce fulfillment facility. Under general supervision, the technician performs critical corrective and preventive maintenance on mechanical equipment, material handling equipment, automated equipment, tools, buildings and grounds. This is a maintenance and repair position that is crucial in the daily operations of the fulfillment center.
Responsibilities
Work with management and lead technicians to prioritize daily tasks and assignments.
Effect repairs on machines, tools, building infrastructure, and other grounds equipment and resources.
Inspect, evaluate, and repair a variety of mechanical equipment.
Regularly uses assigned software to enter work done on work orders, and to track daily tasks & assignments.
Communicate with team members on site and abroad to gather necessary information for accurate repairs.
Maintain accurate records of work performed, parts used, and time taken for tasks.
Read and interpret specifications, diagrams, manuals and other documentation such as standard operating procedures created by engineering and management.
Confer with staff to determine equipment problems; suggest methods of minimizing such problems in an operational setting.
Help to maintain inventory levels of supplies, tools, and replacement parts. Working with management and distribution to ensure stock is replaced in a timely manner.
Follow appropriate safety procedures and work to applicable codes and guidelines, including making recommendations for improvements.
Attend training and safety sessions as assigned.
Basic Qualifications
Equivalent to graduation from high school and three years of experience in the maintenance and repair of a variety of equipment, structures, and facilities such as found in similar industrial settings
Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Write reports, correspondence and procedures.
Effectively respond to questions from staff, other departments’ managers, and technical representatives.
Must be able to use computer systems including but are not limited to: Google Suite, Slack, Microsoft Visual Studio, command prompts, Click Up, and other various software applications.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to recognize, mitigate, and correct unsafe conditions.
Ability to interact with others (co-workers, supervisors, subordinates) in a professional manner; to accept constructive criticism from supervisors, equals, and subordinates; to work as a team member or independently as needed; to prioritize assignments and meet deadlines; to prevent personal problems from adversely impacting your work or that of others around you; to arrive at work as scheduled and to work the shift hours as scheduled.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability, fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations
Additional Requirements
Regularly required to use hand tools, to reach with hands and arms into tight spaces, and to talk or hear in person or on the telephone or radio
Hearing is frequently required for equipment operation analysis
Required to work and walk at elevated heights, using fall protection equipment.
Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl to access necessary equipment.
Occasionally required to smell, using odors to determine process or equipment problems.
Regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 40 pounds, and occasionally be required to lift and/or move more than 50 pounds.
Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
Ability to work on-call/stand-by, overtime, weekends and holidays as needed
Work location is in a warehouse environment with variable temperature including cold, heat and humidity
Exposure to moving mechanical parts; fumes or airborne particles; occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; manufacturing conditions; heat; risk of electric shock; and vibration
Compensation
$40-$45/hr
Culture
We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit!
